set.title: Ship the wiki-tick pane
set.body: A Claude Code pane that reads the work log and shows which items are linked to a tracker.

set.title: CI wiring docs and the GitHub Actions to Azure Pipelines mapping table
set.body: Linked to GitHub by issue number. The pane builds the issues URL from ticketing.project.

set.title: Say which workflows the pane never writes
set.body: The pane is read-only. It does not sync, close, or edit the log.

set.title: Open a Jira issue from the key on the item
set.body: No external.url is stored. The browse URL comes from ticketing.site.

set.title: Refuse a link that is not https
set.body: A javascript: or file: url is ignored. The key is still shown, without a link, unless a safe URL can be built.

set.title: Walk parents without leaving the pane
set.body: Parent is a worklog ULID. Choosing it opens that item here. It does not open the tracker.

set.title: sync --report drift is never masked and the local-only comment is suppressed
